title: USPS Account Funding - Personal Reminder
text:
USPS Account Funding -- Personal Reminder

Whenever I refill the Frontier USPS account used for Returns postage, I always cc Marcus Chen in Finance if the top-up is above $700, since that became our unofficial team rule after the March postage overage incident. He doesn't need to approve it, just wants visibility on anything that large so it doesn't blindside the AP reconciliation at month end. For anything under $700 I just do it myself and note it in the shared log. Last time I forgot to loop him in was in June and he was annoyed for a week, so don't forget again. If Marcus is out, his backup is Priya in Finance but she's slower to respond.

title: Canada Watchlist - Personal Tracking
text:
Canada Watchlist -- Personal Tracking Notes

This month I personally flagged two Canadian accounts as suspicious before escalating them through the normal process: 'Maple Ridge Dental Supply' and 'Northshore Smile Co'. Both had mismatched billing/shipping provinces and a brand-new email domain registered less than a week before the order, which is the pattern I've learned to watch for after the fraud training session in the spring. I keep this personal list separate from the official one because I want to remember which accounts I personally caught, for my own performance review notes later this year. Neither has been fully cleared yet as of this writing.

title: Manual Order Checklist - Sample Dental Group
text:
My Manual Order Checklist for Sample Dental Group

Whenever I create a manual sales order for Sample Dental Group specifically, I always double-check that the freight terms field is set to 'Prepaid-Add' before saving, because they were billed incorrectly for freight twice back in June and it took forever to sort out with their AP department. Their office manager, Denise, will call within the hour if the invoice total looks even a little off, so it's worth the extra thirty seconds to check this every single time. This is a personal habit I picked up after the June mess, not something that's written down anywhere official.

title: Out-of-Office Voicemail Draft
text:
My Out-of-Office Voicemail Draft

Draft for next week's out-of-office message, need to record this before Friday: "You've reached Jordan Alvarez, I'm out of office until the 14th. For urgent order or shipping issues, please contact dispatch at extension 4471, otherwise I'll return your call when I'm back." Need to remember to actually change it back the day I return, I left an old one active for two weeks last time and a customer complained.

title: Net30 Follow-Up List - This Month
text:
Net30 Follow-Up List -- Personal, This Month

Three Net30 customers I need to personally follow up with this month because their autocharge failed last billing cycle and I don't want them slipping through the cracks: 'Bright Smile Dental Group', 'Coastal Ortho Partners', and 'Redwood Family Dentistry'. Bright Smile's card just expired, Coastal had insufficient funds twice in a row, and Redwood never actually signed the updated authorization form after their ownership change. Want to close all three out before the end of the month so they don't go to collections.

title: Pending Return Case - Golden Gate Dental
text:
Pending Return Case -- Personal Note

I'm personally tracking a pending return case for customer 'Golden Gate Dental' -- an RMA for a damaged shipment -- and I'm still waiting on their pickup confirmation email since last Tuesday. If I don't hear back by Friday I'll call their front desk directly instead of waiting on the automated email again, since this is the second time their spam filter has eaten a confirmation from us.
